about: Squidward Tentacles is seen from behind, half in shadow, standing at the round porthole window of his house and peering through the blinds. Outside, SpongeBob and Patrick are jumping around with their arms in the air, clearly having the time of their lives. The image captures the feeling of watching everyone else have fun while you are stuck with work, responsibilities or your own bad mood. In edits the scene outside is labeled with whatever people are enjoying and Squidward is labeled with whoever is left out, often "me".
origin: The frame is from an episode of the Nickelodeon cartoon SpongeBob SquarePants. It spread as a reaction image and object-labeling template in the 2010s.
usage:
The first box sits at the top left over the scene outside the window, so use it for the fun everyone else is having. The second box is at the lower right next to Squidward, for the person watching from inside.

It suits situations like working during a holiday, being sick on a snow day, being grounded, studying while friends go to a festival, or being the only person at a party not drinking. Make the outside label feel joyful and the Squidward label feel stuck to get the strongest contrast.
